title: Akbar teri laash
body:
akbar teri laash uthaye kaise hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dil thaame huwe aur kham hai kamar
beenayi nahi aur zakhmi jigar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay beta zaeefi hai aisi
raasha hai badan mein baba ke
abbas nahi qasim bhi nahi
imdad ki khaatir kaun aaye
liye boj isi gham ka dil par
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadmo ki thakan ne maar diya
din bhar to uthaye hai laashe
sab zabt ke bandhan tooth gaye
beenayi gayi tere gham se
tanha hai sare maqtal ye padar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal teri soorat ki qasam
ab taab nahi hai is dil ko
mai boodha padar aur tum ho jawan
kya waqt pada itna socho
mai bekas o tanha aur muztar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein tujhe roti hai phupi
aur zeb e musalla hai maadar
athara baras paala hai tujhe
tu khud hi bata ay mere pisar
kya beet rahi hogi dil par
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein mere noore nazar
jeete ji mujhe tu maar gaya
naize ki tarha ye gham akbar
hum sab ke dilon se paar gaya
roti hai teri maa ye kehkar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hoo duwayein khaaliq se
qismat na kisi ko de ye gham
ho saamne bete ka laasha
aur baap kare uska maatam
sunle ye dua rabbe akbar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
taqdeer kisi maadar ko bhi
ye gham na dobara dikhlaye
beta ho shabihe payghambar
maa jeeti rahe wo mar jaye
mar jayegi ro ro kar maadar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tere kaleje mein thi sina
hai zakhmi usi se dil mera
kis tarha sina wo khaynchi thi
mai tujhko nahi batla sakta
dil tukde huwe jaata hai pisar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bain kiye sheh ne ban mein
mazhar wo bayan kar sakta nahi
seene pe pisar ke sar rakh kar
ye kehte rahe bas shaahe deen
ab zinda rahoo mai bhi kyun kar
akbar teri laash...
author: Mazhar Abidi
